description: Bang luat S1 (Static Analysis) duoc hieu chuan bang Oracle Proxy va do luong thuc nghiem.
changelog_v4: Phase 1 (S1-A baseline mo rong): them rule/domain moi dua tren tan suat that cua 'uses: action' dang roi vao fallback any_action (xem measurement/analyze_any_action_fallback.py + any_action_fallback_frequency.json, corpus 4.419 file workflow). 2 loai thay doi: (a) MO RONG pattern cua rule co san (docker, sigstore) de bao phu them cac action chinh thuc cung ho - domain KHONG doi, confidence giu nguyen vi co so ky thuat ro rang; (b) rule MOI hoan toan (harden_runner, pypi_publish, codeql_action) - CAN chay validate_static_rules.py de kiem chung ty le khop truoc khi nang confidence, dang o muc 'candidate'.
changelog_v4_2: Them 5 domain vao rule co san dua tren Error/Failure FN breakdown cua measurement/experiment/evaluate_s1_vs_rexec.py (n=371 repo, sau khi sua bug bat doi xung TOOLING o extract_rlog_v2.py): raw.githubusercontent.com (any_action), pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com (ghcr), production.cloudfront.docker.com (docker), packages.microsoft.com (apt), api.scorecard.dev (security_scanners). CO Y BO QUA 3 domain FN con lai vi qua dac thu/chua ro pattern kich hoat, KHONG doan bua: customer-transient-data-<id>.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com (43/371 - ten bucket rieng cua 1 repo, gan id tai khoan, khong khai quat duoc), oss-fuzz-build-logs.storage.googleapis.com (24/371 - dac thu tich hop OSS-Fuzz, chua xac dinh duoc trigger pattern ro rang trong text workflow), keybase.io (19/371 - chua ro co che kich hoat). CO Y CHUA XU LY (theo yeu cau): run-actions-3-azure-eastus.actions.githubusercontent.com (18/371) - nghi la lop tooling thu 3 (ha tang GitHub-hosted runner tren Azure, giong ho hosted-compute-watchdog) nhung de nguyen, chua gan tooling hay them rule workload, cho quyet dinh rieng.
changelog_v4_3: 2 quyet dinh tooling cua Bao (2026-09-12), dua tren doc truc tiep log that (xem measurement/taskb_run_data/logs, vd affinidi_affinidi-tdk-rs, actions-security-demo_compromised-packages): (1) results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com (228 FN, cao nhat corpus) - CHUYEN tu rule 'actions_cache_artifact' (ecosystem=github, dieu kien 'uses: actions/cache|upload-artifact|download-artifact') sang 'github_actions_runtime_infra' (ecosystem=tooling). Bang chung quyet dinh: dong debug cua chinh actions-runner '##[debug][Request] FinalizeCacheEntryUpload https://results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com/twirp/github.actions.results.api.v1.CacheService/...' - day la Twirp API CacheService CUA CHINH RUNNER, khong phai lenh nao trong workflow goi truc tiep; xuat hien ca o workflow KHONG dung actions/cache tuong minh (vd OpenSSF Scorecard, npm publish/attestation) nen dieu kien kich hoat cu (uses: actions/cache...) la SAI - giong het pattern loi da tim thay o actions-results-receiver-production.githubapp.com truoc do. Rule 'actions_cache_artifact' bi XOA (chi co 1 domain, nay chuyen het). (2) run-actions-{1,2,3}-azure-eastus.actions.githubusercontent.com (32 FN) - THEM vao 'github_actions_runtime_infra' cung nhom, xac nhan qua log la ha tang OIDC/token-exchange cua actions-runner (xuat hien cung token.actions.githubusercontent.com/api.github.com trong luong publish/attestation), khong phai dependency cua workload. Da dong bo sang measurement/extract_rlog_v2.py (them 2 domain vao GH_RUNTIME_INFRA_RE) de 2 phia S1/D_static va R_exec dung chung 1 dinh nghia tooling.

rules.note: v4: mo rong pattern them docker/login-action, docker/metadata-action, docker/setup-qemu-action - cung 1 ho action chinh thuc docker/*, cung ha tang registry, khong phai domain moi (xac dinh qua analyze_any_action_fallback.py: 89/81/34 repo dung 3 action nay nhung truoc do roi vao fallback any_action). v4.2: them production.cloudfront.docker.com (KHAC voi production.cloudflare.docker.com da co san - 2 CDN edge khac nhau cua Docker Hub, khong phai trung lap) - phat hien qua Error/Failure FN (35/371 repo).

v4.2: them packages.microsoft.com (kho apt chinh thuc cua Microsoft, dung khi workflow them repo MS truoc apt install - vd .NET, Azure CLI, PowerShell) - phat hien qua Error/Failure FN (26/371 repo). Confidence giu 'medium' vi khong phai MOI apt install deu dung repo MS - chi mot phan.

v4.2: them api.scorecard.dev - phat hien qua Error/Failure FN (26/371 repo), domain KHAC voi api.securityscorecards.dev da co san (khong phai typo/trung lap - 2 hostname phan biet, ca hai deu lien quan OpenSSF Scorecard). CHUA xac minh 100% day la domain chinh thuc thu 2 hay endpoint thay the moi hon - can validate_static_rules.py doi chieu allowlist that de kiem lai.

v4: mo rong them actions/attest-build-provenance, actions/attest-sbom - hai action nay la wrapper chinh thuc cua GitHub goi thang sigstore keyless signing, cung ha tang, khong phai domain moi (51/28 repo, xac dinh qua analyze_any_action_fallback.py).

Domain co dinh bat ke subcommand (issue/pr/release/api/...) - kiem tra thuc nghiem 0/318 workflow dung gh cli co override GH_HOST/GITHUB_API_URL/GH_ENTERPRISE (xem measurement/parametric_locate.py). Khong dua vao Semgrep extraction vi khong can - domain khong phu thuoc argument. GIA DINH RO: chi kiem tra duoc override trong VAN BAN file workflow; gh cli cung co the doc ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml hoac duoc cau hinh qua 'gh auth login --hostname' o ngoai workflow (vd. tren self-hosted runner da setup san) ma static analysis khong thay duoc. We assume no step configures gh for a GitHub Enterprise host outside the workflow file.

v4.1 - MOI, phat hien qua chinh buoc do Precision/Recall/F1 hom nay (khong phai suy doan truoc): day la nhom FN lon nhat cua S1-A (43,3% tong FN, xuat hien o 309/373 = 82,8% repo co bang chung R_exec). KHONG the du doan tu TEXT workflow duoc vi KHONG tuong quan voi bat ky uses:/run: cu the nao - day la ha tang bao cao ket qua job CUA CHINH GitHub Actions runner. 20 shard 'productionresultssaN' (N=0..19) la TOAN BO shard quan sat duoc trong corpus (enumeration tu du lieu that, khong phai doan - co the con shard khac chua quan sat duoc). Pattern 'jobs:' gan nhu luon khop (moi workflow GitHub Actions hop le deu co jobs:) - CO CHU DICH, vi ban chat domain nay la 'chay tren GitHub Actions' chu khong phai 'workflow lam gi'. ecosystem='tooling' -> loai khoi so sanh voi R_exec (WORKLOAD-only), giong cach xu ly harden_runner - day la mot 'mandatory hole' cap do GitHub Actions, tuong tu phat hien CoreDNS/DNS o T4 cap do Kubernetes. v4.3 (xem changelog_v4_3): gop them results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com (chuyen tu rule actions_cache_artifact da xoa - cung ho domain, cung ly do) va run-actions-{1,2,3}-azure-eastus.actions.githubusercontent.com (ha tang OIDC/token-exchange cua actions-runner) - ca 2 deu duoc xac nhan qua doc truc tiep log that, khong phai suy doan.

v4 - MOI, khong phai candidate: domain xac nhan TRUC TIEP tu bang chung DNS that (agent.api.stepsecurity.io, prod.app-api.stepsecurity.io - xem measurement/extract_rlog_v2.py, TOOLING_SUFFIX_RE), khong phai suy doan. ecosystem='tooling' CO CHU DICH khac voi cac rule khac: day la ha tang cua chinh cong cu enforcement, KHONG phai dependency cua workload - khi hop nhat D_static, PHAI loai domain cua rule nay khoi tap so sanh voi R_exec (WORKLOAD-only), giong het cach R_log v2 tach TOOLING khoi R_exec. Neu khong loai, moi repo dung Harden-Runner (1082/4419 file trong corpus) se bi tinh FP gia tao vi R_exec khong bao gio chua domain tooling nay.

v4 candidate - CHUA hieu chuan. Domain dua tren tai lieu cong khai cua action (publish len PyPI/TestPyPI qua Twine/OIDC trusted publishing), CHUA doi chieu voi allowlist that qua validate_static_rules.py. 77 repo dung action nay dang roi vao fallback any_action truoc khi co rule nay.

v4 candidate - CHUA hieu chuan. Domain suy tu co che cong khai (tai CodeQL bundle tu GitHub release, upload SARIF qua GitHub API) - CHUA co bang chung DNS truc tiep nhu harden_runner. Gom ca 4 sub-action (init/analyze/upload-sarif/autobuild), tong 220-312 repo/sub-action, la nhom tan suat cao thu 2 sau harden-runner trong any_action_fallback_frequency.json.

v4.1 - phat hien qua Error/Failure analysis (bucket b, khong co rule nao truoc do): ghcr.io la domain FN pho bien thu 3 cho S1-A (91/373 repo, 2,2% tong FN), la workload That (GitHub Container Registry, dung khi docker pull/push/login voi registry ghcr.io) - KHAC voi github_actions_runtime_infra o tren (cai do la ha tang bat buoc, con day la lua chon co y cua workflow), nen giu ecosystem='container' (workload), khong phai tooling. v4.2: them pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com - kho luu tru THAT phia sau ghcr.io (khi pull/push, request thuc te di qua domain nay), phat hien qua Error/Failure FN (45/371 repo).

Luat co muc do uu tien thap, chi phu tro khi cac action khong khop luat chuyen biet. v4.2: them raw.githubusercontent.com - domain FN pho bien NHAT (62/371 repo, top 1) trong Error/Failure analysis, cung ho *.githubusercontent.com nhu 2 domain da co san.
